name: iam:PassRole + ecs:RunTask
description: Override an existing ECS task definition's container command and task role at runtime using the --overrides parameter of ecs:RunTask — no ecs:RegisterTaskDefinition required
author: Seth Art

required.description: Must cover both the task role ARN (for the taskRoleArn override) and the execution role ARN in the existing task definition
Must have permission to run tasks in the target cluster

additional.description: Discover existing task definitions to exploit with overrides
Find VPCs for Fargate network configuration
Find subnets for Fargate network configuration

admin: An ECS cluster must exist in the account
An existing task definition must be available (no ecs:RegisterTaskDefinition required)
A role must exist that trusts ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com with administrative permissions
A subnet must be available for Fargate launch type network configuration
lateral: An ECS cluster must exist in the account
An existing task definition must be available
A role must exist that trusts ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
A subnet must be available for Fargate launch type network configuration

references.title: Weaponizing AWS ECS Task Definitions to Steal Credentials From Running Containers

options.name: ROLE_ARN
options.description: Target IAM role ARN to pass as taskRoleArn override (must trust ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com)

options.name: CLUSTER_NAME
options.description: ECS cluster name or ARN to run the task on

options.name: TASK_DEFINITION
options.description: Existing ECS task definition family or ARN to exploit via --overrides

options.name: CONTAINER_NAME
options.description: Name of the container in the existing task definition to override (default: first container)

options.name: SUBNET_ID
options.description: Subnet ID for Fargate network configuration (will auto-detect from default VPC if not specified)

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Attach AdministratorAccess policy to an IAM user or role via ECS task container command
